announcements.title: Ice Skating Party
announcements.details: Mark your calendar for our annual church ice skating party. All ages are welcome, and pizza is provided. More details will come this winter.

announcements.title: Food Pantry
announcements.details: The Andrew County Food Pantry November collection is baking supplies: vanilla, baking powder, baking soda, chocolate chips and the like. Bring one or two any Sunday this month.

announcements.title: Next Sunday
announcements.details: Jesus over Creation: in Matthew 14 Jesus walks on the water.
